episodes.154734: A series of storms brought heavy rains to the area.  The rain combined with some snowmelt caused the Coquille River at Coquille to flood.

events.narrative: The Coquille River at Coquille rose above minor flood stage (21.0 feet) at 04/0430 PST.  It oscillated above and below flood stage for a short time at the beginning and ending of the flood.  The river crested at 21.19 feet at 04/0900 PST, and dropped below flood stage for the last time at 04/1330 PST.
